standard_prerequisites.name: The embedding of the derived operad into the free operad on the doubled variables
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: same article, the inclusion used at proof lines 744-746
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows a presentation of an algebra over the derived operad to be transported into the larger free operad.

standard_prerequisites.name: The weight criterion for membership in the derived operad
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: same article, the lemma at source lines 562-568
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the elements of the derived operad inside the free operad as the weight homogeneous ones, which is what makes the differential ideal generated by the relations coincide with the relations themselves.

core_obligations: Present the given algebra over the derived operad as a quotient of the free algebra by an ideal and embed the free algebra into the free operad on the doubled variables (proof lines 741-746).

Form the differential ideal generated by the ideal of relations inside the larger free operad and compare it with the ideal generated by the same relations regarded as relations of the derived operad (proof lines 745-755).

Use the weight criterion to show that the two ideals coincide, so that the algebra is a quotient of the free algebra by relations that already hold in the larger operad, which makes it special (proof lines 755-759).
proof_roadmap: Comparison of the two ideals (proof lines 745-755).
Conclusion through the weight criterion (proof lines 755-759).
